narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} the job ended, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost chose {ghost_choice}, and by that month's close it held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {widest_gap_month} the money was furthest apart, with the ghost holding {widest_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost still held {net_worth_gap}. Its room to last without pay sat {safety_gap}.
